answer: Sybil defence can run through a stake-bond gate that ties every agent identity to collateral it cannot copy. To submit work an agent posts copper-denominated tokens into escrow, so a fresh pseudonym starts at zero and must fund its own bond first. Identities are chained by a thread of settled jobs, meaning one operator launching a thousand clones pays a thousand bonds and waits for each to clear. Cheating slashes the stake, so faking a crowd burns real money. Honest agents keep a modest haven because their bond is refunded and reused, while attackers absorb losses with no refund.
